S PA R K LI N G & C H A M PAG N E 
Prosecco,   Il Baco da Seta Prosecco Doc - Veneto, Italy   (VG) 
Fresh pear & crisp apple meet delicate floral notes, 
soft bubbles and a gentle hint of honey. 
Crémant de Loire,   Paul Buisse NV - Loire, France   (VG) 
Made in the traditional Champagne method, this Crémant delivers fine 
bubbles, fresh citrus & crisp green apple with a subtle brioche note. 
Baron de Villeboerg Champagne,   Brut NV 
- Ville sur Arce, France   (VG) 
A crisp, classic Champagne with vibrant citrus, green apple & subtle 
brioche notes. Fine bubbles & a dry, elegant finish make it a brilliant 
apéritif or celebration pour. 
Moët & Chandon,   Brut NV - Épernay, France   (VG) 
Elegant, vibrant, & widely appealing. It offers a harmonious blend of fresh 
orchard & citrus fruits, layered with brioche sophistication & mineral purity. 
Veuve Clicquot, Yellow Label,   Brut NV - Riems, France   (VG) 
A Champagne icon. Rich & refined, notes of baked apple, citrus, toasted 
almond & vanilla with a persistent delicate fizz & a silky finish. 
Laurent-Perrier, Cuvée Rosé,   Brut - Tour-sur-Marnes, France   (VG) 
Delicate yet expressive, with vivid red fruit, subtle spice & a creamy mousse. 
A benchmark rosé Champagne-perfect for celebrations or a delicious treat. 
Dom Pérignon,   Brut - Hautvillerss, France   (VG) 
A legendary vintage Champagne of exceptional finesse & depth. 
Complex layers of citrus, stone fruit, toast & almond unfold 
over a creamy, persistent mousse. 
Cristal, Louis Roederer,   Brut - Riems, France 
A benchmark of luxury & precision. Notes of lemon zest, white peach & 
fresh brioche. Silky texture, elegant bubbles & a vibrant mineral backbone.

Cinsault Rosé,   Granfort - France 
Soft strawberry & rose petal aromas lead to a balanced palate 
of citrus & red fruit. 
Pinot Grigio Rosato,   Cantina Rosa Bianca - Veneto, Italy   (VG) 
Floral notes & juicy strawberry mingle with subtle minerality 
in thisbeautifully balanced Pinot Grigio ‘blush’. 
Réserve de Gassac Rosé,   Pays de l’Hérault -   Languedoc, France 
Delicate floral aromas, ripe red berries, & a mineral-driven finish. 
A sophisticated rosé that pairs effortlessly with Mediterranean cuisine. 
Provence Rosé,   Château d’Ollières, Coteaux Varois 
- Provence, France   (ORG/VG) 
A quintessential Provence rosé, offering delicate notes of strawberry, 
white peach & rose petal, balanced by crisp acidity & a silky finish 
- pure elegance in every sip. 
Provence Rosé,   Whispering Angel - Provence, France 
Elegant & refreshing, Whispering Angel delivers delicate aromas of fresh red 
berries, ripe peach & citrus blossom. Soft minerality & a crisp, dry finish make 
this Provence rosé refined & effortlessly enjoyable.

175ml   •   Bottle SKIN CONTACT (ORANGE) 
Skin contact whites blur the lines between traditional whites & reds. 
The fresh acidity of white wine combined with the textural richness 
& complexity of reds — perfect for adventurous palates looking for something different. 
“Salamandre”,   Chateau Saint-Cyrgues - Rhône, France   (VG/ORG) 
“Salamandre” showcases the Rhône’s terroir through a unique skin-contact 
style - layered with juicy stone fruit, dried herbs, & a whisper of orange zest, 
perfect for curious palates seeking something different.

- Loire, France   (VG/ORG) 
1/2 BOTTLE -   Chablis,   Gérard Tremblay - Burgundy, France   (VG) 
Chardonnay,   Mappinga Hills   -   Adelaide Hills, Australia 
A bright, mineral-led Chardonnay with lemon, green apple & a subtle hint 
of white peach. Taut & refreshing, with a stony edge & understated texture. 
Sauvignon Blanc,   Massale Selection - Marlborough, NZ   (VG/ORG*) 
Bursting with vibrant citrus, gooseberry & passionfruit aromas, this fresh & 
zesty Sauvignon shows classic Marlborough character. Organically grown 
grapes deliver purity of flavour & a crisp, mineral finish. 
Gavi di Tassarolo “La Fornace”,   Cinzia Bergaglio 
- Piemonte, Italy   (VG) 
Floral & fresh grassy herb aromas, apple, pear & honeydew fruit. 
Elegant with a soft almond butter climax. First class Gavi! 
Côtes-du-Rhône Blanc “Mathilde”,   Clos Saint-Michel   - France   (VG) 
A harmonious white Rhône blend, showcasing fresh stone fruit, 
honeysuckle & subtle hints of spice. Its crisp acidity & smooth mouthfeel 
make it a refined enjoyable choice. 
Picpoul de Pinet,   Chateau de la Mirande - Languedoc, France   (VG) 
Shining with zesty lemon, green pear & sea-spray minerality. Its bright, 
mouthwatering finish evokes the sunny shores of southern France. 
Sauvignon Blanc,   Terrane - South-West, France   (VG) 
An elegant white with lifted aromatics of lime blossom & gooseberry. Zesty 
acidity & a mineral finish showcase the finesse of this terroir-driven wine. 
Pinot Grigio “Trefili”,   Cantina Volpi -   Lombardia, Italy   (VG) 
A breath of Lombardia’s cool breeze. Crisp orchard fruits 
& Spring blossom, finishing with soft almond & mineral notes. 
El Velero Verdejo   - Castilla-La Mancha, Spain 
Bright & aromatic with notes of lime, green herbs & white peach. 
A refreshing Spanish white with a zesty, clean finish. 
Albariño,   Abadia de San Campio - Rias Baixas, Spain 
A refreshing crowd-pleaser—think ripe peach, lime zest & a splash of 
sea salt. Light, lively & great for sharing over tapas or sunny afternoons.

Vinho Verde “Pura Maresia”,   Aphros 
- Vinho Verde Portugal   (VG/ORG*) 
A breezy Portuguese white with citrus, delicate flowers & a salty edge. 
Light on its feet, with mouthwatering freshness & coastal charm. 
Chenin-Torrontes,   Villa Vieja - Mendoza, Argentina   (VG) 
Bright & aromatic, with peach, fresh apple & citrus, 
lifted by delicate blossom & a juicy, refreshing palate. 
Tokaji Dry Furmint ,   Hetszolo - Hungary   (VG/ORG*) 
Dry Furmint is Hungary’s answer to Chablis. 
Crisp, clean & zippy with orchard fruits, lime peel & a touch of smoke. 
`AWAKE` Bianco,   The Wine Love - Rioja , Spain   (VG/ORG*) 
The AWAKE Bianco dazzles with lively citrus & stone fruit aromas, 
rounded out by a smooth, mineral-driven finish. 
Horsmonden Dry White,   Davenport Vineyards 
- Sussex, England   (VG/ ORG ) 
Crafted in the rolling hills of East Sussex, fresh orchard fruits & a touch of 
chalky minerality. Elegant structure & lively finish highlights the emerging 
quality of English whites. 
Meursault Sous La Velle,   Domaine Perrin - Burgundy, France 
Luxurious Chardonnay from one of Burgundy’s most coveted villages, com - 
bining ripe pear, lemon and toasted hazelnut. 
Mâcon Chardonnay,   Les Cadoles -   Burgundy, France   (VG/ ORG* ) 
A graceful expression of southern Burgundy. Crisp orchard fruit, subtle 
minerality & a whisper of oak come together in a wine that speaks softly 
but leaves a lasting impression. 
Sancerre Blanc “La Vigne Blanche” ,   Henri Bourgeois 
- Loire France   (VG/ORG) 
Distinguished Loire Sauvignon from a celebrated Sancerre producer, 
with elegant gooseberry, lime & delicate leafy aromas. 
Beautifully poised, with vibrant freshness & a fine flinty character. 
Chablis 1er Cru “Montmain”,   Gérard Tremblay 
-   Burgundy, France   (VG) 
This Chablis delivers chalky depth, laser focus & elegant acidity 
- an ideal match for seafood, shellfish & high-level conversation. 
Pouilly-Fuissé “Les Héritiers”,   Domaine Thibert 
- Burgundy, France   (VG) 
An accomplished white Burgundy with generous ripe citrus, subtle oak 
& a wonderfully rounded texture. Layers of flavour unfold with freshness 
& precision—a Chardonnay to take your time over.

- Bordeaux, France   (VG) 
Tempranillo ‘Caminante’,   Vina Albergada - Alavesa, Spain   (VG) 
Juicy cherry, cracked pepper & a dry, elegant finish make this a versatile 
pour for tapas, charcuterie, or grilled meats. 
Rioja Crianza ‘Alfaro’,   Vinos Heraclio - North-East Spain   (VG/ORG*) 
Soft oak, ripe red fruit & a hint of vanilla. This Crianza is Rioja at its most 
comforting. Smooth & mellow with just enough structure to keep things 
interesting. 
Mesdi Nebbiolo,   460 Casina Bric - Piemonte, Italy   (VG/ORG*) 
A lighter take on Barolo’s famous grape & super versatile with food. 
Mature & full of personality - think dried roses, red cherries & a hint of spice. 
Le Bosq Carignan,   Badet Clement - Vin de France 
A vibrant southern French red made from old-vine Carignan. Bursting 
with ripe raspberry, cherry & plum fruit, backed by hints of spice & herbs. 
Samurai Shiraz,   Free Run Juice - South Australia   (VG) 
Super juicy & fruity Aussie Shiraz with oodles of blackberry, black cherry 
& plum fruit on a ripe & round medium-bodied palate with a 
little smokey, earthiness. 
Malbec Ballena del Sur   - Mendoza, Argentina   (VG/ORG*) 
“Ballena del Sur” - the southern whale - makes a splash with lush dark fruit, 
subtle spice & undeniable presence. Big-hearted, but beautifully balanced. 
Salice Salentino Riserva,   Marchese di Borgosole 
- Puglia, Italy   (VG) 
Barrel-aged & expressive, this wine delivers layers of dark fruit, 
smoked spice & a subtle wild edge - Puglia’s heritage bottled. 
Amarone Classico “Marask”,   Corte Marconi 
- Veneto, Italy   (VG/ORG) 
A sumptuous expression of one of Italy’s great red wines, made from slowly 
dried grapes for exceptional concentration. Opulent dark cherry, dried plum, 
cocoa & sweet spice combine in a richly textured wine of depth & power.

R E D 
Bordeaux ‘Le Benjamin’ BIO 
- Lalande-de-Pomerol, France   (VG/ORG) 
Certified organic & effortlessly drinkable, this Merlot-based Bordeaux offers 
ripe red fruit, soft tannins & a clean finish. Honest wine from healthy vines. 
Pinot Noir,   La Boussole - Languedoc, France 
Juicy cherry & strawberry, subtle earth notes & a touch of cream make 
this an everyday delight. Light-bodied & friendly, it pairs effortlessly 
with a range of dishes. 
Merlot Duras,   ’Les Petits Clement’ - South-West France   (VG) 
Soft & fruit-forward with notes of ripe plum, blackberry & gentle spice. 
Smooth & rounded with an easy, mellow finish. 
Fleurie ‘Mise de Mai’,   Domaine Zordan 
- Beaujolais, France   (VG/ORG) 
Fragrant & vibrant, with succulent raspberry, red cherry & a delicate floral lift. 
A spirited Gamay with silky tannins, fresh energy & an earthy undertone. 
Estate Pinot Noir Organic,   Clos Henri - Marlborough, NZ   (VG/ORG) 
A refined organic Pinot Noir with bright red cherry, subtle earthiness & a silky 
texture. Pure Marlborough expression with a sustainable soul. 
Margaux Cru Bourgeois,   Château Paveil de Luze 
- Bordeaux, France   (VG) 
This historic estate delivers a supple, aromatic Margaux full of cassis, dried 
herbs & graphite. Aged in French oak, it balances finesse & depth with a long, 
graceful finish. 
Bourgogne Rouge « Le Mondelot »,   Domaine Lacour 
- Burgundy, France   (VG) 
Vibrant, balanced & effortlessly stylish - this Pinot Noir plays well with 
everything from roast chicken to big ideas. 
Barolo DOCG,   460 Casina Bric - Piemonte Italy   (VG/ORG) 
From a rising star in Piemonte, this Barolo balances intensity with purity. 
Think dried herbs, sour cherry & polished tannins - serious but approachable. 
Urbina Gran Reserva Especial,   Rioja - North-East Spain   (VG) 
A distinguished, mature Rioja revealing the complexity that comes with 
patient ageing. Dried cherry & plum mingle with tobacco, polished leather 
& spice, carried by graceful, mellow tannins. 
Volnay 1er Cru “Clos Des Chenes”,   Jean Javillier 
- Burgundy, France   (ORG/VG) 
Smooth yet structured, this is Pinot Noir with polish. Earth, red berries 
& fine tannins make it a brilliant choice for thoughtful conversation.
